audit_reason: The funding page explicitly verifies INN membership. URL Media and LION are documented elsewhere as supporters/collaborators, which is not sufficient evidence of formal membership.
The 2026 impact report documents substantial platform reach and engagement but does not establish institutional dependence. Reach is not equivalent to dependence.
Social media is a third-party platform rather than an owned-audience channel. The report supports WhatsApp and direct web as identifiable direct/owned channels.

Somali Media of Minnesota publicly describes itself as a nonprofit digital newsroom, but this audit did not verify federal 501(c)(3) status. Do not convert a generic nonprofit self-description into tax-specific status.
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer reports Korean Quarterly as a tax-exempt 501(c)(3), EIN 41-1876410.
ProPublica reports 2025 Form 990-EZ revenue of $20,016.
IRS-derived nonprofit records independently verify Sahan Journal's 501(c)(3) status and EIN 83-2745995.
The 23-person figure comes from a 2024 impact report and should not populate a current 2026 staff-count field without a current source. Preserve it as dated historical evidence.
The band is derived from the historical 2024 staff count and should not be treated as a current 2026 size band without re-verification.
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer independently verifies Documented Ltd as a 501(c)(3), EIN 83-3036502.
The 17-person figure is explicitly tied to Documented's 2024 strategic plan and should remain dated historical evidence rather than a current 2026 headcount.
The size band is derived from the 2024 staff figure and should not be promoted to a current value without current verification.
The strategic plan establishes deliberate distribution through WhatsApp, WeChat, Nextdoor and other high-use platforms, but it does not quantify organizational dependence on those platforms.

The strategic plan documents platform distribution but does not disclose the share or centrality of referral traffic. Distribution strategy should not be converted into a referral-dependence classification.
Arkansas GRITA states that it subscribes to INN editorial-independence standards. Following INN standards is not evidence of formal INN membership.
The reviewed public page documents use of INN standards, not a formal affiliation. No formal membership was established in this audit; none_found_publicly does not mean no membership exists.
Independent nonprofit records identify Feet in 2 Worlds, EIN 87-1215486, as an active 501(c)(3) public charity.
Feet in 2 Worlds explicitly states that it is a member of INN and LION Publishers.
ChicoSol states that North Valley Community Foundation is its fiscal sponsor and that its own 501(c)(3) application is pending.
ChicoSol states that operating expenses and writer stipends depend largely on tax-deductible donor contributions to its fiscal-sponsor fund.
The outlet describes a small group of writers and translators but does not provide a defensible current numerical headcount in the reviewed source.
Small-team language is insufficient to assign a numerical staff-size band.
